shortDescription: British telecoms firm Gamma Communications LSE:GAMA agreed to a £1.08 billion ($1.46 billion) takeover including debt, by private equity firm Epiris, the companies said on Tuesday, capping months of takeover interest in the company.($1 = 0.7386 pounds)
